one_line: Evidence-linked Australian tax-return drafting with agent-assisted preparation and human review.

leverage_rationale: Structured WebMCP facts, validation, attestations, and review-pack state make agent-assisted tax preparation materially more reliable than UI driving, especially for provenance and missing-evidence handling.
leverage_evidence: Description says Codex populates structured facts through WebMCP.
AAPL acquisition details trigger a blocker rather than fabricated numbers; user attestation remains distinct.
Frames show staged Income/Deductions/Disposals/Review pack workflow and populated evidence fields.
execution_rationale: The packet is coherent and shows a substantial guided workflow with populated forms and review-oriented states, but no final submitted return is visibly demonstrated.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show consistent ReturnReady workflow screens with progress and populated sections.
Devpost screenshot shows the evidence-linked tax workflow and fallback/manual controls.
Description names concrete deductions, disposals, warnings, and generated review pack.
impact_rationale: Taxpayers and preparers have a concrete recurring problem: consolidating heterogeneous financial evidence without losing provenance; the product directly addresses it.
impact_evidence: Project motivation describes foreign-share and crypto records being manually re-entered each year.

one_line: Agent-native meal planning and grocery preparation with deliberate permission boundaries.
what_it_does: Plans meals, deduplicates ingredients, adjusts pack sizes and shopping deltas, and generates recipes while withholding payment, address, order-history, and spend-limit capabilities.
leverage_rationale: The product makes structured agent permissions central: the agent can plan and calculate but cannot access or change sensitive purchasing controls. This is substantially safer and more precise than browser session automation.
leverage_evidence: Thirteen tools are exposed while four sensitive functions are absent from registration.
Description demonstrates diffs such as dropping a dish and changing the buy list.
CookTree framing explicitly contrasts WebMCP with full browser access or replayable tokens.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a coherent meal-to-grocery workflow with recipe generation, deduplication, pack sizing, and visible cart states; the frames show populated order states, though no completed purchase.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show catalog, selected products, populated cart, changed totals, and configuration states.
Devpost screenshot shows recipes, weekly ingredients, shortage indicators, and generated-dish entry point.
Description gives concrete 21 requests to 16 ingredients and 8 purchases example.
impact_rationale: Meal planners and grocery shoppers have a concrete recurring coordination problem, and the product reduces planning work while preserving financial and privacy boundaries.
impact_evidence: Weekly meal planning, kitchen inventory, deduplication, and shopping preparation are directly demonstrated in the concept.
Sensitive account capabilities are intentionally withheld.
creativity_rationale: The permissioned 'give an AI the kitchen, keep the keys' interaction model is memorable and deeply integrated into a useful domain workflow.
creativity_evidence: Absence of functions is a product feature, not merely an access-control note.
Novel recipe generation flows through the same planning engine.
usability_note: Visible meal cards, ingredient mapping, and cart panel communicate the workflow clearly; purchase completion is not shown.
red_flags: No agent invocation is visible in the supplied image evidence.
advance_reason: One of the strongest packets: WebMCP changes the trust and capability model, with coherent product evidence and a distinctive concept.

one_line: A learner and agent co-draw an incremental knowledge map, expanding only user-selected branches.
what_it_does: Retrofits Excalidraw with WebMCP tools so an agent reads the live canvas, researches questions, adds nodes, and stops for human direction while the learner edits and annotates.
leverage_rationale: The live shared canvas, selection, open-question state, and agent guidance make WebMCP central to the interaction; screenshots and generic UI driving would be markedly less reliable for incremental co-editing.
leverage_evidence: Description exposes map, selection, and open questions as tools.

execution_rationale: The concept is unusually coherent and the packet describes a substantial 17-tool implementation, but the submitted frame evidence is not visually verified here and final end-to-end completion is not explicit.

standouts: Exceptional agent pacing and shared-canvas interaction model.
advance_reason: Highly original and WebMCP-central learning interaction with a credible audience and strong stated implementation.
